questions.n: A larger base lowers bearing pressure.

questions.q: Which statement about pipes embedded in concrete is WRONG?
o: Pipes in a column may take up to 5% of the section area
Pipes in slabs and walls must be under about 1/3 of the thickness
They must not significantly weaken the member
questions.n: The column limit is 4%.

questions.q: A retaining wall with a vertical stem fixed to a base slab is the:

questions.q: In a beam-and-girder floor, which member usually has the shortest span?
questions.n: Girders carry the beams; the beams span the shorter distance between them.
